plan.title: Asset PR to Auction Award and PO

steps.note: Ensure the award is full rather than partial.
Enable eRFX project creation from purchase requisitions.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the required event title.
Commit the 30-minute RFQ schedule.
Add the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the RFQ.
Confirm the RFQ reached its published project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial RFQ quote.
Confirm Vendor A's quote was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's initial RFQ quote.
Confirm Vendor B's quote was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close before conversion.
Convert the published RFQ while retaining its quotes and participants.
Commit the converted auction's bidding schedule.
Publish the converted auction.
Confirm the converted auction is published.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid of 85.
Confirm Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid of 88.
Confirm Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before awarding.
Open the comparison grid for both auction bidders.
Verify the lowest auction amount ranks first.
Verify Vendor A's winning rate is 85.
Verify the awarded line amount and total use rate multiplied by quantity.
Enter the award allocation flow.
Allocate all available line quantity to Vendor A.
Confirm the complete line and vendor allocation.
Create and submit the award proposal to Vendor A.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for full award to Vendor A at 85.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase order.
Verify the PO contains the single awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the completed event's History placement.
Open the History tab.
Confirm the plan's completed event appears in History.
